steps.what: Recent and the rest two cards: two boxes, neither inside the other, as Overleaf's (its background, padding, border, radius, shadow), as wide; between them 12-16 px of the page's background; the folders in Overleaf's, first
steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.olf-recent-card'), b = document.querySelector('#table').closest('.table-container'); const ra = a.getBoundingClientRect(), rb = b.getBoundingClientRect(); const eff = (el) => { for (; el; el = el.parentElement) { const c = getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor; if (c !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') return c; } }; const page = eff(b.parentElement); const gap = rb.top - ra.bottom; const xs = [ra.left + 2, ra.left + ra.width / 2, ra.right - 2]; const mids = xs.map((x) => eff(document.elementFromPoint(x, ra.bottom + gap / 2))); const same = (k) => getComputedStyle(a)[k] === getComputedStyle(b)[k]; return [!a.contains(b) && !b.contains(a), gap >= 12 && gap <= 16, mids.every((c) => c === page), page !== getComputedStyle(b).backgroundColor, Math.round(ra.left) === Math.round(rb.left) && Math.round(ra.width) === Math.round(rb.width), ['backgroundColor', 'paddingLeft', 'borderTopWidth', 'borderTopStyle', 'borderTopColor', 'borderTopLeftRadius', 'boxShadow'].every(same), document.querySelector('#table .olf-rows > tr').textContent, a.querySelectorAll('tr.olf-recent-row').length]; })()
